# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 5

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 005
**Total Disagreements:** 3

---

## Disagreement 1 — "before your face" vs. "right in front of you"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "before your face"
**PNEUMA:** "right in front of you"
**Issue:** The face idiom carries literal and metaphorical weight; "right in front of you" is natural English but loses the face/presence resonance.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Before your face" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "made manifest" vs. "remain concealed" (negative form)

**Verse:** v.2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "will not be made manifest" (positive assertion about revelation)
**PNEUMA:** "will not remain concealed"
**Issue:** The Coptic constructs the sentence positively ("nothing hidden that will not be revealed"). PNEUMA's inversion shifts the rhetorical focus from revelation to the end of concealment.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Made manifest" retained — the positive assertion of revelation is the point.

---

## Disagreement 3 — "raised" vs. "stay underground"

**Verse:** v.3
**EMET/LOGOS:** "raised"
**PNEUMA:** "stay underground"
**Issue:** Critical disagreement. *Toune* = to raise/resurrect. PNEUMA's "stay underground" loses the resurrection double meaning entirely.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Raised" retained; the ambiguity between agricultural rising and resurrection is irreplaceable.

---
